status: design; calculators and cumulative storage not implemented by task 4

passport_defaults.missing_policy: No field/null != zero. Present empty list = observed zero records, not proven full coverage. Unknown denominator -> null. Each metric has its own eligible population.
passport_defaults.version_policy: Metric IDs stable; semantic changes increment method_version. Source revision, code revision, clock/grid/group versions and parameter hash retained. Incompatible versions never merged.

window.window: W=[a,b), with [0,duration+1) for integer-timestamp full-match journal totals; exposure duration is duration seconds. Pregame separate. Requested phases clipped to match end.
window.phase: Consecutive [600*k,600*(k+1)) bins for k>=0, clipped to match duration; absent later bins are censored. The last integer-timestamp bin ends at duration+1 to include final events, but exposure ends at duration. Fixed time bins, not strategic phases.
window.point: Explicit t; last observation <=t and <=5 seconds old where specified.
window.match: One completed match; final source totals distinguished from event sums.
window.kill+90s: Strict (kill_time,kill_time+90], eligible only if full follow-up precedes match end.
window.kill+120s: Strict (kill_time,kill_time+120], eligible only if full follow-up precedes match end.
window.chronology: UTC start/end; collection completeness and left/right boundaries retained.
window.cohort: Explicit selection/date range and as_of; only eligible per-metric match rows.
window.rolling: Last 20 vs previous 20 eligible matches; chronological and disjoint.
window.profile: Profile revision as_of, previous revision and scope.

comparison.identity: Same account/match/slot identity, source namespace retained.
comparison.context: Group by hero + estimated position + mode + phase + known map/source versions; retain lane, both drafts, side, initial team state, rank provenance and missingness. No cross-role pooled judgement.
comparison.chronology: Account + verified chronological adjacency, complete selection boundary; context controls retained.
comparison.cohort: Exact context first; broaden only with explicit dropped dimensions and separately reported composition. Unknown is separate. Prototype n<5 descriptive only; every outcome cell <5 -> insufficient contrast, not evidence of no effect.

retention.raw: Immutable original sources + SHA and pointer indices; needed for new event definitions/quality fixes.
retention.series: Versioned numeric event/time series, source clocks and coverage; targeted recompute possible.
retention.intervals: Episode/death windows with IDs, bounds, censoring; needed for overlaps and changed windows.
retention.sums: Per group n, missing, sum, sumSquares and numerator/denominator sums; additive disjoint updates only.
retention.match: Versioned compact per-match feature row keyed by match/account/method/source revision; supports exact quantiles, deletions and regrouping.
retention.joint: Joint feature/context/outcome rows or predeclared cell counts. Marginals alone cannot answer new correlations.
retention.grid: Versioned cell-seconds, missing time and per-match grid contributions; no silent rebinning.
retention.chronology: Ordered start/end/result/context rows plus boundary state; backdated inserts invalidate affected suffix sessions/runs.
retention.claims: Structured claim revisions, support/counterevidence, analyst version and decisions; never learn only from prior prose.

passport_defaults.aggregation: Exact quantiles use sorted compact match rows and linear interpolation at (n-1)*q. IQR=Q(.75)-Q(.25). Mean=sum/n; sample variance=(sumSquares-sum*sum/n)/(n-1) only for n>1; use a numerically stable equivalent in implementation. Each group stores distinct match count, not event count.
passport_defaults.uncertainty: Descriptive until a validated statistical estimator is implemented. Report sample size, missing/censored/conflicting cases and alternative explanations. Null bounds mean unestimated, not no uncertainty.

metrics.formula: Source identity and all ten hero/side/estimated-position records; preserve source namespaces.
metrics.limitation: Source rank is not verified individual match-time rank. Party null is unknown. Draft IDs do not encode matchup strength.
metrics.verification: Identity agrees across original OD/ST documents; ten unique slots.

metrics.formula: Latest source networth at or before t, age <=5 s; otherwise null.
metrics.limitation: Not earned gold. Do not interpolate gaps or equate with gold_t.
metrics.verification: Reproduce selected original event; check boundary freshness.

metrics.formula: Preserve (time,x,y,slot), source coordinate system and map-version status.
metrics.limitation: Change-event stream is not verified uniform sampling; gaps do not prove absence.
metrics.verification: All ten slots; coordinate/time ranges and gaps, no unverified map transform.

metrics.formula: Sum goldEvents.amount in W grouped by (reason,isValidForStats); never sum categories twice.
metrics.limitation: This is recorded flow, not a reconciled lifetime-income total; preserve unknown reasons and signed values.
metrics.verification: Category sums equal journal total; compare aggregate GPM without forcing equality.

metrics.formula: Sum experienceEvents.amount in W by native reason; record total separately from reported XPM.
metrics.limitation: Not guaranteed complete earned XP; large discrepancy exists. Do not infer level-cap mechanics from this audit.
metrics.verification: Reason sums equal journal sum; preserve residual versus XPM*duration/60 and OD xp_t where available.

metrics.formula: For requested integer target level k>=2, first playerUpdateLevelEvents.time with level>=k; absent attainment is right-censored at match end. Store k in parameters.
metrics.limitation: Pre-game level 1 retained; unattained level is not zero time.
metrics.verification: Monotone level sequence; compare reported final level.

metrics.formula: Count csEvents in W by native flags (isCreep,isNeutral,isAncient); store overlapping flags separately.
metrics.limitation: Ancient may overlap neutral; no guessed disjoint categories. Full-journal count mismatches one match.
metrics.verification: Compare count to final numLastHits; flag mismatch instead of repairing.

metrics.formula: Count target deathEvents in W; empty observed journal with final deaths=0 is valid zero.
metrics.limitation: Count equality alone does not validate all timestamps.
metrics.verification: All ten target death counts agree with final deaths.

metrics.formula: Union intervals [time,time+timeDead), clipped to W and match end. Retain sum(timeDead) as reconciliation value.
metrics.limitation: timeDead semantics not independently verified; buyback can shorten actual downtime; do not call this measured alive time.
metrics.verification: No overlap double count; sum versus union; OD has +/-1 s differences in two parsed games.

metrics.formula: (Final target kills + assists) / sum(final allied kills).
metrics.limitation: Final result only; journal assists unsuitable for unqualified time-window KP. Not all useful actions lead to a kill.
metrics.verification: Bounds [0,1] or quality error; reconcile finals across OD/ST.

metrics.formula: Sum heroDamageEvents.value by attacker,target in W, preserving illusion/unit fields in raw evidence.
metrics.limitation: Do not equate unfiltered event sum with heroDamage or infer effective focus without entity rules.
metrics.verification: Reconcile totals and inspect unit/illusion attribution before making efficiency claims.

metrics.formula: Sum healEvents.value by target; self and other recipients separated.
metrics.limitation: Self healing can exist while final heroHealing=0. Saves and prevented deaths are not observed.
metrics.verification: Keep self/other/unknown sum equal to journal total; compare definitions before final-total reconciliation.

metrics.formula: Minimum purchaseEvents.time per itemId; purchases before zero retained.
metrics.limitation: Purchase is not delivery, assembly, possession or activation opportunity. OD/ST may represent components differently.
metrics.verification: Compare first event to raw pointer, retain missing/censored item and source disagreement.

metrics.formula: Count itemUsedEvents in W per itemId.
metrics.limitation: Counts are not percentage of available opportunities; inventory stream is insufficient.
metrics.verification: Compare to source itemUsed aggregate by ID; unexplained differences flagged.

metrics.formula: Count abilityUsedEvents in W per abilityId and known target.
metrics.limitation: Target 0/unknown is not a miss; use count is not hit accuracy or correct timing.
metrics.verification: Compare source abilityCastReport with attribution limits.

metrics.formula: Count stats.wards by source type and W; retain coordinates.
metrics.limitation: Type codes 0/1 need explicit verified mapping before observer/sentry labels; empty list is observed zero, not verified complete vision.
metrics.verification: Two parsed OD games permit coordinate/time comparison after source-clock mapping.

metrics.formula: Count stats.wardDestruction in W, partition by isWard as native flag.
metrics.limitation: No verified ward-lifetime or resulting visibility gain.
metrics.verification: Compare event counts and typed source flag, not guessed observer/sentry meaning.

metrics.formula: Preserve campStack vector and actionReport scanUsed/pingUsed separately; totals only when vector bin semantics verified.
metrics.limitation: No automatic usefulness score; minute-vector indexing is not established by field names.
metrics.verification: Check saved schema and individual source events where available; mark unvalidated bin alignment.

metrics.formula: Count towerDeaths by (native npcId,side,time), keeping unknown attribution.
metrics.limitation: Source list may include different structures; verified npcId dictionary needed before tower-tier or barracks labels. OD full objectives only 2/10.
metrics.verification: Compare matching typed OD objective events after clock alignment; no last-hit attribution as sole contribution.

metrics.formula: D(t)=sum(allied networth)-sum(enemy networth), requiring ten fresh snapshots; band ahead if D>1000, behind if D<-1000, else near-even.
metrics.limitation: 1000 is a versioned prototype band, not a win predictor. Sensitivity at 500/2000 belongs to validation.
metrics.verification: Same timestamp/freshness for all ten; compare ST lead series only after bin alignment.

metrics.formula: For eligible target kills with 90 s follow-up inside match, mark any target death in (kill,kill+90]; report unique deaths separately.
metrics.limitation: Not causal or necessarily a mistake; dependent overlapping windows. Kill-journal mismatch makes this metric ineligible for that match.
metrics.verification: Exclude right-censored kills; dedupe deaths for totals; do not exclude match from unrelated metrics.

metrics.formula: From estimated death interval end to first cs/heroDamage/towerDamage event; none -> right-censored.
metrics.numerator: first activity time - estimated interval end
metrics.limitation: Not return to useful play: movement, protection and vision omitted; buyback/end-time uncertainty propagates.
metrics.verification: Expose activity kind and end estimate; no negative duration; censor at next death or match end.

metrics.formula: 60*sum(xp.gain in phase)/(phase end-phase start).
metrics.limitation: No claim of total earned-XP rate until source discrepancy resolved; phase clock must be covered.
metrics.verification: Weighted phases reconstruct match recorded sum, not reported XPM.

name.en: Phase gold flow and net-worth change

metrics.formula: Recorded flow per minute by reason; networth(end)-networth(start) separately.
metrics.limitation: Networth growth and income are distinct; missing endpoint makes delta null.
metrics.verification: Check additive flow; endpoint telescope only across fresh adjacent bounds.

name.ru: Доля этапа в записанных интервалах смерти

metrics.formula: death.reported_time(phase)/(phase end-phase start).
metrics.limitation: Not avoidable time lost; stage intersections can span several phases.
metrics.verification: Range [0,1]; phase numerators sum to whole-match union.

metrics.formula: 60*count(farm.last_hits in phase)/(phase end-phase start).
metrics.limitation: Recorded rate flagged when full journal disagrees with final count.
metrics.verification: Additive counts and denominators; no average of unequal-duration rates.

metrics.formula: At target event time t, min Euclidean distance to fresh allied hero coordinates; max age 5 s for every required point.
metrics.limitation: Freshness can discard stationary observations; distance is not support availability or map path length. No meters without calibration.
metrics.verification: Null when required points unavailable; sensitivity to freshness; verify hero/entity attribution.

metrics.formula: For consecutive target observations separated <=5 s, credit previous cell duration; longer gaps wholly unknown. Fixed native-coordinate bins require a validated grid version.
metrics.limitation: Coverage=credited/phase duration; do not call unobserved periods base time. Named map regions deferred.
metrics.verification: Cell seconds+unknown seconds=phase duration after clipping; no double count across phase bounds.

metrics.formula: At fixed phase boundaries compute delta D/minutes; count changes of band on 60 s grid with fresh ten-player snapshots.
metrics.limitation: Missing grid breaks sequence; no inferred transition across missing points. Not player causal impact.
metrics.verification: Reconstruct deltas and transitions from saved numeric grid.

metrics.formula: Keep fixed-phase vectors of XP, gold flow/networth, farm, death fractions, team-state deltas; attach quality per component.
metrics.limitation: Do not force variable-length matches into a final phase with zero values; missing phases are censored.
metrics.verification: Recover whole-match additive totals and all null/quality flags.

metrics.formula: Target networth / sum allied networth at t=600,1200,1800,... and final fresh point.
metrics.limitation: Not share of earned gold or justified resource allocation; longer matches contribute only to eligible timestamps.
metrics.verification: All allied values at same time; sum five shares=1.

metrics.formula: Among target kills with full 120 s follow-up, count those followed by allied typed building destruction; retain baseline all eligible 120 s time bins.
metrics.numerator: eligible kill windows with allied object
metrics.limitation: Requires killEvents completeness and npcId/side validation; timing does not prove conversion or personal responsibility.
metrics.verification: No crossing source clocks without verified transform; overlap/dependence flagged.

metrics.formula: Sum phase grid seconds per cell, divide by observed seconds; retain phase and role splits.
metrics.limitation: Equal-game and time-weighted maps are different products. Low coverage does not describe full-match movement.
metrics.verification: Match grid equals sum of phase grids with same version.

metrics.formula: Sort (start_time,match_id); gap=start(current)-end(previous). New session iff gap>3600 s; previous result, ordinal and result-run length only when history adjacency is verified.
metrics.limitation: First match is left-censored; missing historical match breaks adjacency; ranked-only selection is not complete gaming history. No fatigue/tilt claim.
metrics.verification: Use UTC gaps and 30/60/90 minute sensitivity; negative gap -> quality conflict; preserve last end/result/run for append.

metrics.formula: For each eligible context group and metric, store n,missing, sum,sumSquares, min,max, mean, exact median/IQR from compact match rows; rates also keep pooled numerator/denominator.
metrics.denominator: eligible match n or pooled denominator
metrics.limitation: Mean per match differs from pooled rate; n of matches, not number of events, is evidence size. No percentile versus other players without reference data.
metrics.verification: Merge by disjoint match IDs; compare incremental versus rebuild; retain raw rows for exact quantiles.

metrics.formula: For predeclared feature band B and context C: wins(B,C)/n(B,C) minus wins(not B,C)/n(not B,C); retain 2x2 counts and compact joint rows.
metrics.limitation: Descriptive association only; final-game stats leak outcome and duration, not pregame predictors. Sparse classes in current 9W/1L prohibit stable claims.
metrics.verification: Explicit eligibility, both cell sizes, threshold version and tested-hypothesis count; temporal holdout and multiplicity validation in task 10.

metrics.formula: Compare eligible metric distributions by session ordinal and previous result within same context; keep adjacent-pair deltas and pair counts.
metrics.limitation: Conditioning on continued play selects who/when remains; no psychological cause. Unknown boundaries excluded from ordinal/run statistics.
metrics.verification: No cross-gap pairs; no future result as previous-result feature; cohort counts and threshold sensitivity.

metrics.formula: Compare last 20 eligible games with preceding 20 in same context; output n/mean/median/IQR and differences, requiring complete windows for trend labels.
metrics.limitation: 20 is prototype parameter; insufficient windows -> unavailable trend, no zero. Hero/role mix changes reported separately.
metrics.verification: Chronological disjoint windows and no baseline contamination; raw observations not raw match events.

metrics.formula: Compare cell distributions by role/phase/team-state/outcome with observed-time denominators and distinct match counts.
metrics.limitation: Small/low-coverage cells hidden from conclusions; map versions never silently merged.
metrics.verification: Compare equal-game versus time-weighted views; preserve grid coverage and grid version.

metrics.formula: Analyst links L5 conditional evidence to style, strengths and growth experiments; every claim records supporting/opposing numeric groups, limits and next check.
metrics.limitation: Numbers do not uniquely determine labels; no automatic psychological diagnosis or assertion of avoidable error. Missing families explicitly remain unknown. Spatial input is optional and may be explicitly unavailable; core profile cannot require a missing additional metric.
metrics.verification: Immediate L5 references, alternative explanation, counterevidence, confidence rationale and user-actionable check.

metrics.formula: Given previous claims and changed L5 summaries: retain/support/weaken/refute/defer each affected claim; version profile even when text is unchanged.
metrics.limitation: Unchanged prose may accompany updated coverage. Do not apply fixed trait learning rate or silently forget older counterexamples.
metrics.verification: All changed groups accounted for, previous revision linked; explanation refers to conditions, examples only in drill.

metrics.formula: Not defined until cooldown, mana, inventory state, visibility and target eligibility are reconstructable.
metrics.limitation: Inventory contains only one pregame event; complete cooldown/visibility absent. Cannot calculate unused-BKB or spell-opportunity rates.
metrics.verification: Requires independent state reconstruction validation before enabling.

metrics.formula: Not defined without ward lifetime, terrain, visibility and detection state.
metrics.limitation: Placement coordinates and source isWard flags do not measure vision gained; OD lifecycle only 2/10.
metrics.verification: Validated map/visibility reconstruction required.

metrics.formula: Map coordinates to verified versioned region polygons before aggregating time.
metrics.limitation: No verified map coordinate transform/polygons in current prototype; native grid can be explored separately.
metrics.verification: Known landmarks and map-version tests before lane/jungle/base labels.

metrics.formula: Do not derive matchup strength from hero IDs alone.
metrics.limitation: Requires approved trait definitions/reference data and validation; meta disabled. Exact draft IDs remain usable group context.
metrics.verification: No undocumented hero scoring or external population benchmark.

metrics.formula: No causal trait calculation from event statistics.
metrics.limitation: A worse game after a loss does not establish tilt, fatigue, intent or character. Observed game behaviour can support a cautious hypothesis for discussion.
metrics.verification: Do not publish causal/diagnostic labels as measurements.
